name: Block editor
description: A document editor made of blocks: headings, lists, tables, callouts, code, images and files. Type / to add a block, and drag the gutter handle to reorder.

classes.ayy-block-editor: Root. The editor renders its blocks inside it, then the floating menu, formatting bar and caret anchor. Leave room at its inline start for the gutter (about 3.25rem of padding in its container), or use --inset.
classes.ayy-block-editor--inset: Keeps the gutter inside the editor's own box, for containers with no padding to hang it in.
classes.ayy-block-editor__block:
One block. data-type says what it is; data-indent (1–4) nests it, data-checked marks a done to-do, data-open a toggle showing the blocks nested under it (a closed one hides them), data-tone (info, success, warning, destructive) colours a callout, data-rendered an equation whose renderer returned HTML, data-selected a block in a block selection, data-dragging one being carried. In plain HTML you can write just
Title
; the editor builds the rest.
classes.ayy-block-editor__gutter: The + and the drag handle at the block's inline start; shown while the pointer is over the block (on touch screens, next to the line being written).
classes.ayy-block-editor__add: The + button: a new line below with / typed, so the block menu opens. Alt-click adds it above.
classes.ayy-block-editor__handle: The drag handle (.ayy-drag-handle): drag to move the block, or every selected block; click for block actions (duplicate, move, delete, turn into, and Colour › on a callout).
classes.ayy-block-editor__text: The editable line of a text block (contenteditable, role="textbox"). Inline content: strong, em, u, s, mark, code, links and mention chips. Shows data-placeholder while empty. An equation's line is named Equation; the TeX is its text. The line is clipped — not removed — while data-rendered math is showing.
classes.ayy-block-editor__marker: A list's bullet or number, drawn by the editor (1. a. i. by nesting level).
classes.ayy-block-editor__toggle: A toggle's arrow button: points along the reading direction, turns down while the toggle is open (aria-expanded). Blocks indented under the toggle (data-indent greater than its own) are hidden while it is closed.
classes.ayy-block-editor__table-wrap: A table block's box: the scrolling table, the row grips at its inline start, the drop line for a dragged row or column, the + at its inline end (add a column) and the + under it (add a row).
classes.ayy-block-editor__table-scroll: Scrolls the table sideways in a narrow column, with room at the inline start and top for the row and column grips. The hairline is on the table, not this box.
classes.ayy-block-editor__table: The <table>. A header row is a <thead> of <th scope="col">; the rest is a <tbody>. A selected row or column paints data-selected on its cells. In plain HTML a block with data-type="table" can hold a <table> and the editor reads its rows.
classes.ayy-block-editor__cell: The editable plain-text line inside every cell (role="textbox", data-row, data-col). Tab and Shift+Tab move between cells, Enter goes down a row.
classes.ayy-block-editor__col-resize: The handle on a table column's inline-end edge, in the first row (role="separator"): drag it to set the column's width. The same widths are set from the column grip's menu (Width) for keyboard users.
classes.ayy-block-editor__table-add: A table's + button (data-axis="column" or "row"): shown while the pointer or focus is in the block, always on touch screens.
classes.ayy-block-editor__row-grip: The handle at a table row's inline start (data-row, aria-haspopup="menu"): shown while the pointer is over that row, including the lane beside the table (data-hot). It hides when the pointer leaves the table. Click selects the row and opens its menu (insert, duplicate, move, clear, delete); drag reorders the row.
classes.ayy-block-editor__col-grip: The handle over a table column's top (data-col, aria-haspopup="menu"): shown while the pointer is over that column, including the lane above the table (data-hot). It hides when the pointer leaves the table. Click selects the column and opens its menu (insert, duplicate, move, sort, align, width, clear, delete); drag reorders the column.
classes.ayy-block-editor__icon: A callout's icon: a bulb by default, then information, check, alert or cancel as data-tone changes. It takes the tone's colour.
classes.ayy-block-editor__math: An equation's rendered output, a sibling after the TeX line, aria-hidden="true". Shown only while the block has data-rendered and is not being edited. Clicking it focuses the line. The line is named Equation and the TeX is its text; this HTML is hidden from screen readers.
classes.ayy-block-editor__code-bar: A code block's header, over the top of the code: the language at the start, Copy at the end (shown on hover).
classes.ayy-block-editor__code-button: A button in the code header: the language (opens a menu of languages; plain text in read-only) or Copy (a check while copied, data-copied).
classes.ayy-block-editor__media: The <figure> of an image or embed block.
classes.ayy-block-editor__frame: The box around an image, a player or a link card. data-ratio="video|audio|square" sizes a provider's player.
classes.ayy-block-editor__resize: The handle on an image's inline-end edge (role="separator"): drag, or use the arrow keys, to set its width.
classes.ayy-block-editor__caption: An image or embed's editable caption (also the image's alt text). Its placeholder shows on hover and focus.
classes.ayy-block-editor__bookmark: An embed of a page that isn't a player: a quiet card with the site and the address.
classes.ayy-block-editor__bookmark-title: The site's name in a link card.
classes.ayy-block-editor__bookmark-url: The address in a link card, truncated.
classes.ayy-block-editor__file: A file block: a link to download it, with its icon, name and size.
classes.ayy-block-editor__record: A record link: a button card (icon, name, source). Clicking it fires the mention click, in read-only too. With no record yet it says "Pick a record".
classes.ayy-block-editor__record-label: The record's name, stored on the block. Not looked up again if mentions later changes.
classes.ayy-block-editor__record-source: The trigger and id the record was linked from, muted. Empty until one is picked.
classes.ayy-block-editor__empty: An image, embed or file block with nothing in it yet: a muted panel with a link field and an Upload button. aria-busy="true" while a file uploads.
classes.ayy-block-editor__mention: A mention chip inside text (contenteditable="false", data-trigger, data-id, data-label): text with a faint wash, never a loud pill.
classes.ayy-block-editor__mention-trigger: The @ or # of a mention, muted.
classes.ayy-block-editor__menu: The floating list (.ayy-combobox__listbox) for /, mentions, block actions, a table row, column or cell menu, and a code block's language. data-mode="slash|mention|actions|language".
classes.ayy-block-editor__submenu: A menu that opens beside an item (Colour, Language, Row, Column, Sort, Align, Width), rather than replacing the list. A further one can open beside that.
classes.ayy-block-editor__menu-label: A group heading in the menu (Basic blocks, Media, People, Turn into).
classes.ayy-block-editor__option: One menu row (.ayy-combobox__option, role="option"). data-current marks a block's current type, data-destructive Delete.
classes.ayy-block-editor__option-icon: The tile in front of a menu row: the block type's icon, or an Avatar for a person.
classes.ayy-block-editor__option-text: A menu row's name and hint.
classes.ayy-block-editor__option-hint: A menu row's muted second line.
classes.ayy-block-editor__toolbar: The formatting bar (.ayy-toolbar--floating) over a text selection: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlight, code, link. Over a link it shows the link's address.
classes.ayy-block-editor__link-form: The link field in the formatting bar, with Open and Remove.
classes.ayy-block-editor__anchor: A hidden box the script places over the caret or the selection for the menu and the bar to hang from.

default.looks: Plain text on the page: no borders or boxes; headings in --ayy-font-heading; lists, quotes, callouts and code in their own quiet styles. The gutter is hidden.

hover.looks: Its gutter (+ and the drag handle) fades in at the inline start; a hovered image shows its resize handle and its caption placeholder; gutter buttons, link cards, file rows and record cards get --ayy-color-wash.

pressed.none: No pressed look: pressing the handle starts a drag or opens block actions, pressing text places the caret.

focus.when: A line with the caret (:focus inside .ayy-block-editor__text), or the editor itself while blocks are selected; :focus-visible on the gutter buttons, the resize handle, link cards, file rows and record cards
focus.looks: The caret, and an empty line's hint (Type / for blocks). Selected blocks show their tint; buttons and handles get the 2px --ayy-color-ring outline.

disabled.none: Use readOnly to show a document that can't be edited.

selected.when: data-selected on blocks (Esc in a line, Shift+click, Mod+A twice, or the handle's menu) or on a table row's or column's td/th (its grip menu)
selected.looks: A 12% --ayy-color-primary tint behind the block or the selected cells; images, players, files and record cards also get the --ayy-color-ring outline. Forced colours: a Highlight outline.

error.none: No error look on the editor; a link that isn't a valid URL marks the link field (aria-invalid) instead. Say why a save failed in an Alert or a toast.

loading.when: aria-busy="true" on .ayy-block-editor__empty while a dropped, pasted or picked file uploads
loading.looks: The media panel dims to 60% and stops taking the pointer until the file's URL arrives.

checked.when: data-checked on a to-do block (its checkbox, or Mod+Enter in the line)
checked.looks: The checkbox is checked; the text turns --ayy-color-muted with a line through it.

open.when: data-open on a toggle block (its arrow, or Mod+Enter in the line)
open.looks: The arrow turns down and the blocks nested under the toggle show; closed, they are hidden (hidden attribute) but stay in the value.

tone.when: data-tone="info|success|warning|destructive" on a callout (Colour › in its block actions)
tone.looks: The wash becomes an 8% tint of --ayy-color-info, --ayy-color-success, --ayy-color-warning or --ayy-color-destructive, and the icon takes that colour. Default has no data-tone: --ayy-color-wash and a muted bulb. Forced colours: a CanvasText border and icon on Canvas.

resizing.when: data-active on .ayy-block-editor__col-resize while a table column is dragged
resizing.looks: A 2px --ayy-color-primary line shows on the column's edge; the columns follow the pointer live.

hot.when: data-hot on the grip of the row or column under the pointer, including the lanes beside and above the table
hot.looks: That grip fades in. It hides when the pointer leaves the table.

dragging.when: data-dragging on the blocks being carried by the handle, or on the cells of the table row or column being dragged by its grip
dragging.looks: They dim to 40%; a raised copy follows the pointer and drag-and-drop's 2px line (data-drop-edge) shows where they'll land.

empty.when: data-empty on the root: the document is one empty line
empty.looks: The placeholder shows in that line, focused or not.

typing.when: data-typing on the root: set by typing, cleared when the pointer moves or presses
typing.looks: The gutters and code blocks' Copy fade out, so nothing moves beside the words being written.

read-only.when: readOnly / the readonly attribute (aria-readonly="true" on the root)
read-only.looks: No gutter, carets, placeholders or empty media panels; checkboxes are disabled, links, mentions and record cards open on click.

sizes.density: Text follows the type scale (body --ayy-text-md, headings 3xl, 2xl and xl), not density. Menu rows, the formatting bar and the media panel's field and button follow the control sizes, so data-density="touch" makes them bigger; the gutter buttons stay 1.5rem.
sizes.width: Fills its container; images and embeds fill the column (an image can be resized from 20% to 100%). The gutter hangs about 3.25rem outside the inline start, or inside with --inset.

js:
blockEditorClass({ inset?, className? }) → string; connectBlockEditor(root, { value?, placeholder?, label?, readOnly?, mentions?, upload?, renderMath?, onChange?, onMentionClick? }) → { getValue, setValue, setOptions, focus, destroy }; blockEditorBlock(type, fields?) makes a block; blockEditorNormalize(value) cleans one; blockEditorToMarkdown, blockEditorFromMarkdown, blockEditorToHtml and blockEditorToText convert (no DOM needed); a callout's tone is info, success, warning or destructive (absent is default; Markdown uses GitHub alerts, [!NOTE] [!TIP] [!WARNING] [!CAUTION], and [!IMPORTANT] imports as info); blockEditorMentionHtml({ trigger, id, label }) is a mention chip for a block's html; blockEditorCodeLanguages lists the languages a code block offers (block.language holds the id, highlighted with Code block's tokenizer); blockEditorEmbed(url) says what an embed block shows; blockEditorCleanHtml(html) keeps only the inline HTML the editor makes. A record block stores { trigger, id, label } and exports as trigger plus label in text and Markdown, and as

label

in HTML; Markdown import does not turn that text back into a record block. An equation block stores escaped TeX; Markdown is a $$ fence, HTML is
\[tex\]
, and renderMath(tex) supplies the shown HTML.

element.description:
Makes the .ayy-block-editor inside it a block editor. The starting blocks are the ones written inside it (short form:
Done
) or a
element.children: A <div class="ayy-block-editor"> of blocks, and optionally a <script type="application/json" data-mentions> with mention lists.

attributes.placeholder: Shown while the document is empty.
attributes.label: Accessible name of the editor (default "Editor").
attributes.readonly: Show the document without editing it.

events.ayy-change: { value } — every block, after each change.
events.ayy-mention-click: { trigger, id, label } — a mention chip or a record card was clicked.

BlockEditor.renders: <div class="ayy-block-editor"> that the editor fills with blocks

props.value: BlockEditorBlock[] — the document, controlled (pass back what onChange gives you).
props.defaultValue: BlockEditorBlock[] — the document to start with, uncontrolled.
props.placeholder: string — shown while the document is empty.
props.readOnly: boolean — show the document without editing it.
props.mentions: BlockEditorMentionSource[] — { trigger, label?, options } per trigger; options is a list of { id, label, hint?, avatar? } or a (query) => list or Promise of one.
props.upload: (file: File) => string | Promise<string> — store a pasted, dropped or picked file, return its URL. Default: a data: URL.
props.renderMath: (tex: string) => string — turn an equation block's TeX into HTML. Without it, the TeX shows as typed. A throw or an empty result shows the TeX.
props.onMentionClick: (mention: { trigger, id, label }, event: MouseEvent) => void
props.inset: boolean — keep the gutter inside the editor's box.
props.aria-label: string — accessible name of the editor (default "Editor").

a11y: Name the editor (aria-label in React, label on <ayy-block-editor>): it's a role="group" of lines, each a role="textbox" named by its type (Text, Heading 1, To-do list).

Everything works from the keyboard: Enter, Backspace and the arrows move through blocks; Tab and Shift+Tab nest; Mod+Enter opens or closes a toggle, whose arrow is not a tab stop; in a table Tab and Shift+Tab move between cells (Tab in the last one adds a row), Enter goes down a row and adds one after the last, Mod+Enter adds a row below, the arrows leave the table at its first and last row, Mod+Shift+arrows move the row or column (dragging its grip does the same), a cell's Mod+/ or right-click opens its menu (Row ›, Column ›, Header row, Header column, Clear every cell, then the block actions), the row and column grips open a menu scoped to that row or column and select it (insert, duplicate, move, clear, delete — columns also sort, align and set width), and the block handle's menu holds the table-wide items (→ opens a group, ← or Esc goes back); a callout's block actions include Colour › (Default, Info, Success, Warning, Destructive); Esc selects the block (then ↑/↓, Shift+↑/↓, Delete, Mod+D, Mod+Shift+↑/↓, Enter to edit again); Mod+/ opens block actions, Mod+Alt+0–8 turns a block into another type, Mod+B/I/U, Mod+Shift+S, Mod+Shift+H (highlight), Mod+E and Mod+K format. Tab nests, so the way out of the editor is Esc twice, then Tab.
Screen readers hear an equation's TeX, not its rendered math: the text line stays available (named Equation) and the rendered HTML is hidden.

The / and mention menus keep focus in the line: ↑/↓ move through aria-activedescendant, Enter or Tab picks, Esc closes without closing a parent Dialog. The block actions menu takes focus and gives it back.

Opening a row or column grip's menu selects that row or column (Esc closes the menu and leaves it selected). Delete or Backspace clears it, Mod+Backspace or Mod+Delete deletes it, Mod+D duplicates it, Mod+Shift+arrows move it (left and right follow the reading direction), Mod+C copies it (a row is tab-separated, a column is one value per line), Mod+X copies then clears it, and Esc puts the caret in its first cell. Clicking a cell clears the selection.
Block selections, moves and failed uploads are read out in a polite live region.
Images take their caption as alt text: write one for every picture that carries meaning.
do: Use a Block editor for documents people write and come back to: notes on a task, a page in a wiki, a spec, a long description with headings, lists, to-dos and media.
Store the value (blocks) as it is, or convert it with blockEditorToMarkdown / blockEditorFromMarkdown when the storage is Markdown, and render it elsewhere with blockEditorToHtml.
Pass mentions for the people and records your app has (@ for people, # for issues), with a function when the list is long or remote.
Pass upload so pasted, dropped and picked files go to your storage instead of the default data: URLs.
Pass renderMath (for example KaTeX's renderToString) so equation blocks show as math, and keep that library in your app so ayywi's bundle stays small.
Keep tables for short, plain facts (a price list, a schedule). Cells are plain text, one line each, up to 100 rows and 12 columns; a spreadsheet pasted into a cell fills the cells from there.
dont: Don't use a Block editor for a short reply, a comment or a single field — use Textarea, or Mentions when the text needs @mentions.
Don't wrap it in a bordered box like an input: it's the page. Put it straight in the page or a Card, with room at its inline start for the gutter (or --inset).
Don't trust a value from elsewhere as HTML: pass it through the editor or blockEditorNormalize, which keep only the inline HTML it makes.
